description: React component for an auto-expanding textarea with customizable max height and styling.

classes.name: AutoExpandingTextarea
classes.description: React component that renders a textarea which automatically adjusts its height based on content, up to a maximum height.

methods.name: adjustHeight
methods.description: Adjusts the height of the textarea element based on its scrollHeight, respecting the maxHeight limit.

methods.name: handleInput
methods.description: Handles input events, triggers height adjustment, and calls external onInput handler if provided.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles change events, triggers height adjustment, and calls external onChange handler if provided.
